name: calcora-ai
description: Digital AI Scientific Calculator and mathematics workbench

scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist-electron/main.cjs
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const p of ['dist','dist-electron','server.js']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:core && npm run test:tutor && npm run test:intelligence && npm run test:learning && npm run test:multilingual && npm run test:multilingual-input && npm run test:multilingual-adversarial && npm run test:multilingual-response && npm run test:math && npm run test:math-100 && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:tutor-guard && npm run build
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never
